title: Melanie Morrow
seoTitle: Melanie Morrow - Practice Manager | Client Services
description: Melanie has over 20 years’ experience in family law, having commenced her career in 2001 as a Personal Assistant
html:
Melanie has over 20 years’ experience in family law, having commenced her career in 2001 as a Personal Assistant and over time has progressed to Practice/Accounts Manager. Melanie’s strong attention to detail and high level of organisation ensures the Practice runs seamlessly.

Over the years Melanie has developed an excellent understanding of the importance of empathy and transparency when dealing with clients, particularly when it comes to managing legal costs.

Melanie prides herself on her compassionate approach and has a strong desire to help clients during what can be a very challenging time in their lives.
